Title: The Southern Campaign and the Sun Stands Still
DateApprox: c. 1406 BC or c. 1230 BC (date debated)
Places: Gibeon; Aijalon; Makkedah; Libnah; Lachish; Eglon; Debir; Jarmuth
Events: After the Gibeonites make a treaty with Israel, Joshua defends Gibeon against five Amorite kings, and the sun stands still over Gibeon and the moon over the Valley of Aijalon while Israel completes the victory.
